newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Intellect to bid for Techway.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Intellect to bid for Techway.

text.p: Intellect Holdings Ltd said it will make a takeover offer for Techway Ltd in a counter-bid to a previous offer by Nova Pacific Capital Ltd.

Intellect said it will offer one of its shares for every 2-1/2 Techway shares. Based on Monday's closing price of 98 cents for Intellect, the offer values each Techway share at 39.2 cents and Techway's 12.6 million issued shares at A$4.9 million.
Techway shares closed at 31.5 cents on Monday.
In a separate statement, Techway said its board indicated it will recommend shareholders accept the Intellect bid in the absence of a higher offer and urged rejection of the Nova bid.
Nova Capital launched a 30 cents a share on-market cash offer for Techway on January 10.
It then said it had secured options over 10 percent of Techway's issued capital from its two largest shareholders.
Intellect said it designs and develops solutions for electronic payments and networks, including smart card readers and cryptographic processors.
It said it has been in talks with Techway for some months about Techway's WEB Australia division which provides Internet banking systems.
